description: Get design tokens for a specific design system. Returns colors, typography, spacing, radii, elevation, and motion tokens in W3C DTCG, CSS custom properties, or flat format.

format.description: Output format: dtcg (W3C standard), css (custom properties), flat (key-value). Default: dtcg

group.description: Filter to a token group: color, color-dark, color-light, typography, spacing, radius, elevation, motion

name: get_design_system
